I've looked up your order ORD-1042 (wireless earbuds, ordered October 26th) and can confirm it is currently in transit but delayed at the regional hub in Chicago. The last tracking scan was on November 3rd. Your estimated delivery date is November 7th.

I understand how frustrating it is when a package doesn't arrive as expected. I want to make this right for you.

According to our policy, if a package is more than 7 days past its estimated delivery date or if tracking hasn't moved for 5 days, you have the option to choose either a full refund or a free reshipment of your order.

Please let me know which option you'd prefer—a refund or reshipment—and I'll process it for you right away.

Again, I apologize for this delay and for any frustration our support team may have caused.
